articles.title: Cove Capital Investments, LLC Completes the Acquisition of a Single Tenant Net Lease Industrial Distribution Facility in New Mexico for Its Cove Essential Net Lease Industrial 106 DST in a 100% Debt-Free Transaction
articles.mainIdea: Cove Capital Investments, LLC Completes the Acquisition of a Single Tenant Net Lease Industrial Distribution Facility in New Mexico for Its Cove Essential Net Lease Industrial 106 DST in a 100% Debt-Free Transaction
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Cove Capital Investments, LLC Completes the Acquisition of a Single Tenant Net Lease Industrial Distribution Facility in New Mexico for Its Cove Essential Net Lease Industrial 106 DST in a 100% Debt-Free Transaction. Cove Capital Investments, LLC, a Delaware Statutory Trust sponsor company that specializes in providing accredited investors access to debt-free options for their 1031 exchange and direct cash investments, announced it has recently established the Cove Essential Net Lease Industrial 106 DST, a Regulation D, Rule 506(c) offering that is targeting $$5,505,718 in equity. The newly acquired facility is a strategically located industrial distribution center in New Mexico.
